description: An operations director must decide whether to authorize an overnight production run on Furnace 4 and finalize the staffing and atmospheric-safety controls before the shift begins, with input from workforce planning and environmental health and safety.

shared_context.S1: Furnace 4 is available for an overnight production run of heat-treated brackets.
shared_context.S2: The normal Furnace 4 operating sheet lists two qualified operators for an 8-hour standard shift and routine gas-purge checks before loading.
shared_context.S3: Mara has authority to authorize the overnight run and set the conditions for operating it.
shared_context.S4: At the production-readiness meeting, the operations director routinely asks workforce planning and environmental health and safety to report any relevant staffing, training, permit, or atmospheric-control requirements before authorizing an unusual shift.

PF1.text: Jon checked the current training records this afternoon and confirmed that exactly three operators are certified for Furnace 4; all three must be assigned to the overnight run, which is scheduled as an exact 10-hour shift, to cover loading, controls, and unloading, and the workforce roster has not yet synchronized this update to the production schedule.

PF2.text: Priya's permit review after this week's argon-cylinder replacement requires continuous oxygen monitoring during the overnight run, with the alarm set at exactly 19.5% oxygen, plus a documented purge verification before loading; the authorization must include a purge-verification commitment, and she completed the review today but has not yet updated the furnace permit packet.

acceptance_conditions: The overnight Furnace 4 run must be authorized.
Exactly three certified operators must be assigned to the run.
The shift must be scheduled for exactly 10 hours.
Continuous oxygen monitoring must be required with the alarm set at exactly 19.5% oxygen.
Purge verification must be completed before loading.
A purge-verification commitment must be recorded.
The permit review must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C7: any(c.get('type') == 'purge_verification' or 'purge verification' in c.get('requirement', '') or 'Purge verification' in c.get('requirement', '') for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The current training records change the staffing plan from the normal two operators and 8-hour shift to exactly three certified operators assigned for exactly 10 hours.

The permit review changes atmospheric control from routine purge checks to continuous oxygen monitoring at exactly 19.5%, requires pre-loading purge verification, and requires a commitment covering that purge verification plus cited justification.
